title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Fizzy Cherry Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Energize your vaping experience with the sugary pop of Fizzy Cherry flavour in these SKE Crystal 4in1 prefilled pods. The vivid cherry flavour, paired with a fizzy sherbet sensation, offers an exhilarating taste for an enjoyable MTL vaping experience. Each pod is filled with Nic-Salt vape juice for consistently smooth puffs. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods replicate the popular flavours of SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes in a more cost-effective and eco-friendly format. Designed for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these easy-to-use pods fit seamlessly into the device's rotating mechanism, allowing you to enjoy four flavours in one handy vape kit.
